head: # Campaign: dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2 — intent and constraints

Written 2026-11-14 before launch (CLAUDE.md, autonomous mode). Source of truth: the user's 2026-11-14 request to set up DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's conc1+P90 campaign following the proven pattern of Muse Spark Campaign5 (`musespark-c1-p90-sa`) and Kimi K3.1 Pro (`arbor_kimik31pro/kimik31pro-c1`), using the `arbor-ci-campaign-setup` skill. Supersedes two stalled 2026-11-12 attempts (see "Relationship to
## Goal

Run a 24 h **Arbor standalone** campaign on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with vLLM, MI355X, AgentX trace replay at **concurrency 1**, with **P90 interactivity** (`e2e_norm_intvty_p90`) as the objective, without losing P50 interactivity. Before and after the campaign, run the full AgentX benchmark at C1 and GSM8K (the proven musespark-c1-p90-sa pattern — the two prior DSv4.1 attempts never got this far).

## Exact C1 server launch (from the recipe, already resolved by the prior attempts — reused verbatim)
env: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
vllm serve <model_path> --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --host 0.0.0.0 --port <port>
--tensor-parallel-size 4 --language-model-only --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v41
--enable-auto-tool-choice --reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 --moe-backend aiter_triton_mxfp4_bf16
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9
--speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic",
"rejection_sample_method":"synthetic","synthetic_acceptance_length":3.51,
"enable_adaptive_verification":false}'
--max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 2 --max-cudagraph-capture-size 16 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384
--disable-uvicorn-access-log
(`max-num-seqs`/`max-cudagraph-capture-size` are CONC-derived: `MAX_NUM_SEQS=2*CONC`, `CAPTURE_SIZE` = first power of two ≥ `2*(1+5)` — already computed for CONC=1 above.)

Acceptance is **synthetic** (3.51), matching CI — this is the launch mode the stalled attempts' v0.9.8-avoidance reasoning was about; see the Arbor row in Pins for the full picture (user-specified `v0.9.2-baseline-test` for this campaign, that reasoning not independently reconfirmed for this version).
## Decisions (inherited from the 2026-11-12 attempts, unchanged)
- **Objective:** `e2e_norm_intvty_p90` (max), KEEP bar +2%; guard `e2e_norm_intvty_p50`, band 5% (judged on matched requests).
- **Bench cache:** cold — Arbor restarts the server before each bench (vLLM's `/reset_prefix_cache` needs dev mode, which the CI env doesn't set).

- **Profiling:** kernel tracers (rocprofv3, ruppell, torch profiler) **hang vLLM on this image** (rocprofiler-sdk 1.3.2, confirmed 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-12, ruppell-board#10 c8680). One ruppell try capped at 15 min, then tracer-free profiling only (`/metrics` split, py-spy with `AMD_SERIALIZE_KERNEL=3`, sync-timed segments) — this is already written into the pack's lifecycle directives (`stage/pa
- **Bench length:** 3600 s, as CI (a 600s replay at C1 only holds ~25 requests — too few for a usable P90). ~12-15 measured iterations fit in 24h.

Both prior attempts got CI archaeology, `config.json`, `pack.yaml`, and node provisioning (`prepare.sh`) fully right — reused near-verbatim (only `session_root`/`docker_container`/`port` and the Arbor-version-dependent bits changed). ## Relationship to prior attempts (not deleted, kept for history)

- `experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90` (MB-driven): 8 restart attempts (`full2`...`full9`) chasing Hyperloom/Arbor version bugs; last died after ~1h with no `MB-branches` ever created. Superseded — going standalone per the proven Muse Spark/Kimi K3.1 Pro pattern instead of retrying MB.

- `experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90-sa` (standalone): fully provisioned (`PREPARED` touched, venv+pack+config installed) but no `campaign.sh` ever written; `sessions/` empty; hold job 283952 is long gone. Its `config.json`/`pack.yaml`/CI archaeology is reused directly in this new attempt; the directory itself is left as-is (not reused in place, to avoid ambiguity about what ran where).
## Layout (once built)

- `experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2/`: this guide, `env.sh`, `dl.sh`, `prepare.sh` (adapted from the dead `-sa` dir, paths updated + bench_agentx.sh install step added), `ab.sh` (new), `campaign.sh` (new), `stage/` (`arbor_v092bt.tgz` + `bench_agentx.sh` reused from `musespark-c1-p90-sa/stage/`; `pack.yaml`/`config.json` reused from the dead `-sa` dir with its Arbor-version references updated), `runs

- New container name + port (avoid any confusion with the dead `-sa` dir's `qh_c1sa`/`8893`, even though the old node is gone): proposed `qh_dsv41c1b`, port `8894` — confirm no collision with the currently-running Campaign5 node (different node anyway, but checked).

- Node: a fresh hold job — current cluster `squeue -p amd-spur-v2` shows heavy PD contention from other users (many `QOSGrpNodeLimit`/`Dependency` reasons); only our own job 285229 (Campaign5, still running) is active. Submitting a new hold job should be fine QOS-wise but may queue behind others.
## Constraints

Never touch other users' containers or processes. Smoke test first. Do not loosen gates, tolerances or CI flags without the user; record any CI deviation. No tokens (GitHub, board, HF) inside the container. Log every action in `reports/<date>_worklog.md`.

config.goal: Raise DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash P90 interactivity (e2e_norm_intvty_p90) on the InferenceX AgentX replay at concurrency 1 on four MI355X GPUs, from the CI launch, without losing P50 interactivity.
config._server_flags_note: Verbatim from the recipe for CONC=1 (base/c1.launch.sh of experiments/dsv41f-c1-p90): MAX_NUM_SEQS=2*CONC=2, CAPTURE_SIZE=first power of two >= 2*(1+5)=12 -> 16. Arbor adds the model path, --served-model-name, --host, --port and --tensor-parallel-size 4.
config._server_env_note: The first seven are the recipe env. HF_HUB_* point at the offline cache (the node NVMe hub: refs/main = the model pin, plus the 062126 corpus, both fetched fresh by dl.sh, not assumed from a prior job node). AGENTX_TOKENIZER makes aiperf load the tokenizer by repo id from that cache, as CI does (offline aiperf rejects a path). The rest is what bench_agentx.sh reads (InferenceX conventions). DURATION 3600 as CI: at C1 a 600 s replay holds about 25 requests, too few for a P90.
config._bench_cache_note: Arbor restarts the server before each bench (vLLM reset_prefix_cache needs VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE, which the CI env does not set).
config._objective_note: P90 plus 2 percent to keep; P50 held within 5 percent (judged on matched requests; the P90 itself is read raw). Inherited unchanged from dsv41f-c1-p90-sa 2026-11-12 operator decision.
